ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) base pixels occupying approximately 92% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/light tan) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered circular scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-grey field across both lobes. High-contrast white/tan geometric clusters localized at the far-left and far-right lateral tips. Sparse distribution of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular rings (0.5-2.0% surface area) across the medial and distal sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a rounded vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the superior margin; irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; presence of jagged protuberances more pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave-upward curves originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convex curve near the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular white/tan calcified clusters at the extreme lateral tips (barnacle colonies). Numerous high-contrast white rings (approx. 10-25 pixels in diameter) scattered across the ventral surface indicating barnacle attachment/detachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-right lobe and several fine horizontal scratches near the lower central peduncle attachment point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes consistent with parasitic attachment or barnacle scarring; heavy calcified barnacle encrustation at both distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent, solid high-intensity white circular spot located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
